summary.tldr: Raises the full Old Age Security pension, increases the income exemption for the guaranteed income supplement, and changes related pension calculation rules.
what_it_does: Raises the full monthly Old Age Security pension to $808.45 for the payment quarter starting July 1, 2025.
Raises the amount of employment income and self-employed earnings that is ignored when calculating the guaranteed income supplement from $5,000 to $6,500, for benefits payable after June 2025.
Sets the increase for people who apply for a partial monthly pension after becoming eligible at 0.6% for each month until their application is approved.
Updates Old Age Security formulas that use the full monthly pension amount, including a rule that rounds one calculated amount up to the next multiple of four dollars.
who_it_affects: People with employment or self-employment income
summary.background: The bill amends the Old Age Security Act. It changes the rules for the full pension, the guaranteed income supplement, and some related calculation formulas.
